propositions: Code review must compile and execute DiscoveryStagePlan units from CriteriaSnapshot through the shared kernel, respecting effective disables, project file applicability, and explicit dollar budgets.
When one criterion fails, code review must retain earlier successes and continue independent criteria, returning INDETERMINATE only if blocking-capable coverage is missing and no real block exists.
Positive authored usd_budget values must be enforced with over-budget units shed before calls; zero budget is schema-invalid and uncapped is the default.
Base-reviewer summary, one-hop Round B recommendations, sequential scheduling, per-overlay context, and authored code-review.yaml topology must remain unchanged from pre-cutover behavior.
Internal versioned discovery trace must be persisted in the code-review journal sidecar and never exposed in the review response or status projection.

Shadow contract tests must confirm no response/status schema changes and report mismatches only within the approved delta allowlist (effective disable/retune, project DET inclusion, applicability, budget enforcement, partial-failure verdict).
